name: NestedDrawer
title: Templates/Platform/Forms/NestedDrawer
summary: A create drawer whose select needs a related resource that may not exist yet: the list page opens a large Add Instance drawer, and the Create Service option pinned to the foot of its Service select opens a second, medium drawer stacked above it on raised layers. Saving the child adds the new service and selects it back into the parent. Each drawer is its own scoped save, and each clears its fields and errors when it opens, so its content stays in place while it closes. Built from the platform shell, `Button`, `Drawer` and its parts, `PanelHeader`, `PanelContent`, `PanelFooter`, `Card`, `Item`, `Input`, `Select` and `HelperText`.
